findings.title: Fresh-prompt regression test does not require references to resolve to the exact graph
findings.criterion_ref: PKGV2-T11 requires the automated test to “fail on a missing, stale, or mismatched reference” and prove every binding resolves to the enforced graph.
findings.trigger: A prompt uses a wrong prefixed path such as `--graph other/execution_package_v2/implementation.graph.v4.yaml`, or retains a correct whitespace-form reference alongside a stale equals-form reference such as `--graph=execution_package_v2/implementation.graph.v1.yaml`.
findings.consequence: The regression suite remains green even though the prompt instructs execution against a missing or mismatched graph, recreating the class of consistency failure T11 is intended to prevent.
findings.evidence: Bundle lines 2283–2286 define `_GRAPH_FLAG_PATTERN = re.compile(r"--graph\s+(\S+\.yaml)")`, which ignores equals-form flags. Lines 2321–2325 validate only `reference.endswith(expected_suffix)`, so any wrong prefix ending in `execution_package_v2/implementation.graph.v4.yaml` passes without resolving to `PACKAGE_GRAPH`.

observations: The currently embedded N00, N20, and N30 prompts themselves use graph bindings that resolve to `implementation.graph.v4.yaml`, and the preserved v3 fixtures contain the documented stale v1 bindings.
The live plan validator reports `valid: true`; admitted Phase-A hashes, source-spec digest, write ownership, scan modes, result paths, and current git-status scope matched the stated criteria.
The full pytest command could not be rerun in the read-only environment because Python could not create a temporary file. This environmental limitation is not an artifact finding.
reasoning: The graph, scanner, validator, ownership, versioning, and current prompt content survived inspection. T11 nevertheless requires an automated proof that rejects mismatched prompt bindings, not merely correct current text. The parser’s whitespace-only extraction and suffix-only comparison leave realistic stale or nonresolving bindings undetected, so one major finding survives.
